name: kazap
description: Claude Code plugins published by Kazap Tecnologia

plugins.name: adversarial
plugins.description: Adversarial review of a design, plan, spec or code: read-only lenses calibrated to the content, an independent skeptic for critical/high defects, and fixes applied only after confirmation or with --fix. Optional cross-model review adds models you authorize from OpenAI (Codex CLI), Google (Antigravity CLI) and other makers (opencode), sending content to them.
